title: US building twice as much gas-fired capacity as China in AI boom, analysis finds
notes: Supports US gas-turbine/datacenter claims: US building 2x (up to ~3x incl. announced) China's gas capacity, 76% H1 increase, 252->378GW, $647bn, +20% US power emissions estimate, gas-turbine backlogs, IEA forecast US fossil power spending to outstrip China.
